reading.next:
It is born off. Switch it on from the inbox once the backtest reads the way you want — three days out of the last thirty is a watch that speaks when something has actually moved, not every morning.

If three is too many, I'd tighten it to two weeks under in a row rather than one, and backtest again before it goes on; if it is too few, the same week last year is the other baseline worth trying.

When it fires, the post will carry the week and the figure with its receipts, and the first thing I'd do is open Greenhills and look at who came in and what they bought — the basket shrinks either because fewer lines go in each bag or because the dear lines are missing from the shelf, and only the shop can tell those apart.
